Delhi Metro Stations Reopen After Temporary Closure

Several Delhi Metro stations, including Rajiv Chowk, Mandi House, and Central Secretariat, were temporarily closed for security reasons. The closures caused inconvenience to passengers trying to catch trains and flights. Services have since been fully restored after the situation normalized.
